reason: I already order through my Instagram page and they know me and find my house. Most of what I buy is small cheap stuff like makeup and accessories, and with 13,000 a kilo plus 5,000 delivery and the buying fee, a 10,000 dinar item ends up costing me double, so I don't see why I would switch to someone new.
objection: Shipping per kilo makes small cheap items not worth it, and I don't know if they charge a full kilo when my order is only 200 grams. Also a new page I have never heard of, I'm not sending them money up front.
would_change_my_mind: If they charged shipping by the real weight with no full-kilo minimum and let me combine many small items in one shipment, and a friend I trust had already received an order from them.
